results.name: ModelRuntime reuse
results.detail: The coding-agent ModelRuntime serves durable generation without AgentSession.

results.name: History fork
results.detail: A new conversation sees the parent history at the selected entry.

results.name: Image adapter
results.detail: SDK read tool returns a PNG through durable model context; native durable read rejects that same PNG.

results.name: Codemode package reuse
results.detail: Standalone QuickJS sandbox returns 42 inside a durable tool. Nested-call replay policy still needs design.

results.name: Owned child
results.detail: A durable tool creates, awaits, and reads an owned child conversation. This does not load pi-subagents.

results.name: Turn-ending tool and custom state
results.detail: Termination avoids the next model request, with reply state committed first.

results.name: Manual compaction
results.detail: Compaction commits a summary while retaining old transcript entries and the custom reply document.

results.name: Event stream
results.detail: Committed message and tool events observed; message_end uses entry, not coding-agent message.

results.name: Reopen, deduplication, reconnect
results.detail: The same request ID finds its settled submission; custom state and transcript snapshot survive SQLite reopen.
